question: What is Technical Asset Management (TAM)?
answer:
Technical Asset Management (TAM) is all about keeping your property structurally and functionally sound, protecting its value over time.

Unlike standard property management, which focuses on tenants and appearances, TAM focuses on the building’s core systems and long-term health.

We identify risks and maintenance needs before they become costly problems, giving you confidence in your investment.

question: How is it different from traditional property management in Athens?
answer:
Traditional property management mainly handles:
  • Tenant relations
  • Occupancy and bookings
  • Cleaning, styling, and aesthetic upkeep

Technical Asset Management, by contrast, focuses on:
  • Structural integrity of the building
  • Mechanical systems (HVAC, plumbing, electrical)
  • Data-driven reporting and long-term planning

Think of us as the invisible layer protecting your property’s value. We work behind the scenes so your investment keeps performing.

question: When should I order a Red Flag Technical Scan?
answer:
Think of this as your “Go / No-Go” filter. Use it before engaging lawyers or paying for a full audit.

It focuses on the context and obvious deal-killers that the listing often hides:
  • The Environment: Is the street safe at night? Are there abandoned buildings or brothels next door?
  • The Building (Polikatoikia): Is the entrance maintained? Broken mailboxes or dirty hallways often indicate a bankrupt HOA (Koinochrista).
  • The Unit: Quick visual check for layout issues, major cracks, or obvious neglect.

Goal: Prevent wasting €500+ on legal fees for a property that should have been rejected from the street corner.

→ Stop wasting time on bad listings. Book a Red Flag Scan.

question: What does a Golden Ticket Technical Audit include?
answer:
The Golden Ticket Audit is a full technical evaluation. We check six asset classes:
  • General Environment: Overall building health and safety
  • Electrical Systems: Safety, functionality, and efficiency
  • Plumbing and HVAC: Flow, pressure, and overall integrity
  • Joinery and Closings: Doors, windows, and fittings
  • Finishes and Surfaces: Wear, moisture, and hidden damage
  • Amenities and White Goods: Refrigerator, oven, dishwasher, and other built-in appliances

We use advanced tools like thermal imaging and stress tests to produce a risk-rated roadmap, helping you plan maintenance and investments strategically.

Beyond the Surface: Our thermal imaging identifies hidden moisture, insulation gaps, and thermal bridges that the naked eye misses entirely.

→ Get a comprehensive view of your property’s health with a Golden Ticket Audit.

question: How does CapEx planning impact long-term value?
answer:
CapEx (Capital Expenditure) planning helps you forecast major investments over a 5-year horizon, ensuring you:
  • Avoid costly emergency repairs
  • Protect the property’s value and yield
  • Make strategic upgrades at the right time

By understanding the lifecycle of roofs, HVAC units, and other critical systems, you can manage your portfolio proactively, not reactively.
